ASHINOKO GT — KUROTORA DRIVE

KUROTORA vehicle and the Ashinoko scene are the project owner's supplied assets.
The road network, lake shoreline and building footprints derive from OpenStreetMap.
© OpenStreetMap contributors — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Elevation data derives from Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (国土地理院).
https://maps.gsi.go.jp/development/ichiran.html

This project is an approximate artistic reconstruction for an arcade driving game.
The display route has been smoothed for driving; scenery, dimensions and materials include artistic assumptions.
It is not a surveyed road model or an officially verified fictional racing circuit.

Three.js — MIT License. The complete license is in vendor/LICENSE.
Meshoptimizer — MIT License. The complete license is in vendor/MESHOPT-LICENSE.md.
Its compression is used without quantization: decoded geometry buffers retain exact original bytes.
